steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Republic was a mixed constitution with monarchical (consuls), aristocratic (Senate) and democratic (assemblies) elements | Key Fact: Two consuls were elected annually with imperium (power of command); they could veto each other (intercessio) | Key Fact: The Senate was the most powerful body: 300 patrician elders who controlled foreign policy, finances and state religion | Key Fact: The comitia centuriata (centuriate assembly) elected consuls and declared war; voting was weighted by wealth

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from roman government &amp; the constitution, and one past-paper question.
